data.name: Indhira
data.gender_notes: Indhira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Indhira is derived from the Arabic word 'indhar', meaning a star. This name is associated with the story of the Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) and the star that guided him during his trials. The name Indhira carries the meaning “A star” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Indhira usually hope their child will grow to embody a star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Indhira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Indhira total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
